title: census.py confirm exits 1 on a census log that names a source row since deleted from _sources.csv
goal: census.py confirm on a census log whose rows include sources deleted from _sources.csv after the census (settled as cited by no article) dates the confirmed sources it still knows and names the others, instead of exiting 1 with 'log ids not in _sources.csv'

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e)
        sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import argparse, contextlib, csv, io, os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import census, factdiff
kb = tempfile.mkdtemp()
census.KB = kb
head = "id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by"
open(os.path.join(kb, "_sources.csv"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(head + "\nS1,https://example.com/a,t,p,MIT,copy,2026-10-01,,,,\n")
factdiff.census_baseline = lambda *a, **k: {}
log = os.path.join(kb, "census.csv")
rows = [{c: "" for c in census.COLS} for _ in range(2)]
for r, sid, bucket, outcome in zip(rows, ("S1", "S9"), ("OK", "GONE"), ("", "gone")):
    r.update(id=sid, url="https://example.com/" + sid, kind="page", bucket=bucket, outcome=outcome, proof="read " + sid)
census.write_log(log, rows)
out = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
    rc = census.cmd_confirm(argparse.Namespace(log=log, date="2026-10-21", dry_run=False), {})
text = out.getvalue()
srcs = {r["id"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(kb, "_sources.csv"), encoding="utf-8", newline=""))}
assert rc == 0, ("confirm exits non-zero on a census log with a source deleted from _sources.csv", rc, text[-300:])
assert "S9" in text, ("confirm does not name the log id it does not know", text[-300:])
assert "confirmed 2026-10-21" in srcs["S1"]["version_or_date"], ("the source it still knows was not dated", srcs["S1"])

clauses.clause: census.py confirm on a census log whose rows include sources deleted from _sources.csv after the census (settled as cited by no article) dates the confirmed sources it still knows and names the others, instead of exiting 1 with 'log ids not in _sources.csv'

notes: Planner 2026-10-24 (day triage, SP-4ppjbh4k): the repro was run once on the base ff0fdad94 and fails for the premise. The repro runs confirm on this clone's real 2026-10-21 census log; check 0 plants a temporary root and log with one known and one deleted source, so a hand edit of the real log cannot satisfy it.
